name: FOLLOW.ART
summary: Portfolio card platform for artists and curators, with a searchable directory and direct financial support.
description: Members create a shareable digital Card that gathers portfolio, biography, experience, links and contacts, discoverable through the Connectory directory and a Community Board with open calls and collaborations. A free Starter Card covers a basic portfolio, while PRO plans from $4.99 a month add extended links, QR and Wallet sharing, studio visit bookings and card statistics. A Support My Practice button lets audiences contribute directly, and the site says it keeps no algorithm between members and viewers.
